preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string s in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.
The maximum number of operations k is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: All characters in s are lowercase Latin letters.
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase Latin letters only.

postconditions.expression: The output is a string that is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by performing no more than k operations.
postconditions.description: The output string must be the lexicographically smallest possible string that can be obtained by performing no more than k operations on the input string s.
